description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called DocsScreen, which displays a list of documents with Ocean styling and an upload FAB. It uses Provider for state management via DocsProvider, and includes UI components for listing documents, showing snackbars, and a floating action button for uploading fake documents.

classes.name: DocsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays a list of documents with Ocean styling, using provider for state management, and includes a FAB for uploading new documents and snackbar notifications.

methods.name: _showSnack
methods.description: Displays a snackbar message in the current scaffold context.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the DocsScreen, including app bar, list of documents, and FloatingActionButton.
